title.zh: 将奎松省Polillo市镇Polillo医疗社区医院床位由十五（15）张增至二十五（25）张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Polillo Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Polillo, Province of Quezon, From Fifteen (15) To Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Polillo Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Polillo, Province of Quezon, From Fifteen (15) To Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Polillo Medicare Community Hospital tại Thị trấn Polillo, Tỉnh Quezon từ mười lăm lên hai mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของ Polillo Medicare Community Hospital ในเทศบาล Polillo, จังหวัด Quezon จากสิบห้าเป็นยี่สิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Polillo Medicare Community Hospital di Kotamadya Polillo, Provinsi Quezon dari lima belas menjadi dua puluh lima tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Polillo Medicare Community Hospital di Perbandaran Polillo, Wilayah Quezon daripada lima belas kepada dua puluh lima katil

text.en: The bed capacity of the Polillo Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Polillo, Province of Quezon, is hereby increased from fifteen (15) to twenty-five (25) beds.
The municipal hospital shall be composed of compe-tent personnel as prescribed by the Department of Health.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be charged against the lump-sum appropriations authorized for the purpose under the current General Appropria-tions Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the hospital shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
